administrative_area.description: The locality of the address. For US addresses, this corresponds to the state of the address.

country_code.description: The two-character (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) country code of the address.

extended_address.description: Additional street address information about the address such as, but not limited to, unit number or apartment number.

locality.description: The locality of the address. For US addresses, this corresponds to the city of the address.

postal_code.description: The postal code of the address.

street_address.description: The primary street address information about the address.
